limitations: 52/237 reviewed source-contract instructions is not a functional completion percentage, binary match or visual-fidelity score.
Normal-roster Reset confirmation, durable default restore, cancel/failure/retry/restart/relock already have isolated host coverage. Source accounting for callback/restore remains pending.
States7/27 table selection is tested at the C API only; the native frontend does not implement career/season context routing.
Created-player reconciliation and overflow dialog remain unwired until created-player data/runtime support exists; do not erase created records or pretend default-only reset covers that path.

Shared confirmation, flashes, pointer rebuilding, ownership/counts, ranking, allocator and save functions are excluded from this bounded denominator. Help-style shading, original transition cadence and audio waveforms remain separate.
